info.title: Google.Cloud.Tools.SecretManagerHelper
info.description: Tool used by Google .NET release processes to fetch secrets from Secret Manager. While there is nothing "secret" in this package, it is unlikely to be useful to other developers. It is only published as a matter of convenience for other Google .NET repositories.

options.name: --project
options.description: Required. Name of your Google Cloud Project.

options.name: --secret
options.description: Required. Name of the secret to fetch from Secret Manager.
